== Notes ==
* In [[Normal mode]], the [[AI]] will only use this skill on a foe wielding a [[martial weapon]] (similar to [[Eruption]] and [[Signet of Midnight]]). In [[Hard mode]], the AI will only use this skill on a [[Martial#Martial details|martial]] primary [[profession]] foe wielding a martial weapon. This is similar to [[Throw Dirt]]. <!--Tested on Doppelganger-->
{{anomaly|This skill can be used on a spirit but it will not inflict blindness.}}
